generic_rules: A no silent evidence-class promotion (token change ⇒ promotion record)
B every promotion needs a TYPED sensitivity witness (pre-fix-fail | injected-fault-fail | subject-reach | mutation-verdict-flip) with receipt hash / source identity
C conditional claims require conditions + a trust profile
D executed evidence distinguishable from unexecuted artifacts (executed flag, receipt path, tool/runtime identity) before TESTED
E OPEN requires enumerated open findings
F historical falsifiers are append-only (pre-fix + repair witnesses preserved on FALSIFIED→TESTED)
G derived counts are computed, never typed
H the station has its own mutation tests
attrs.statement: A control may promote an evidence class only if its sensitivity to the claimed forbidden state is itself evidenced — at least one of: (A) pre-fix or injected-fault execution demonstrates FAIL; (B) an independent witness demonstrates that the control reaches the intended subject and discriminates the forbidden state; (C) a mutation/negative-control pair proves that removing the target mechanism flips the verdict. A green-only control with no demonstrated failure sensitivity cannot support promotion.
attrs.status_text: READY FOR A FACTORY PROMOTION ROUND (GPT v3 §17) — NOT minted by this lane; generic validator kit in tools-lane/factory-kit/ (rules A–H, typed, project-agnostic, with its own mutation selftest)
